block.json.description: One-layer QwenImage21Transformer2DModel (non-block weights plus block 0 or block 31 in slot 0, f32) over 20 text tokens and a 4x4 target at sigma 0.704534: per-stage tensors, the full block-causal path and the prefix-KV-cache path.

block00_block_in.f32.description: Block input [36, 4096]: 20 text then 16 image tokens.

block00_cached_out.f32.description: Cached-path model output for the target tokens [16, 64] at sigma 0.704534.

block00_k_head0.f32.description: k after RMSNorm and RoPE, head 0 [36, 128].

block00_model_out.f32.description: Model output over the joint sequence [36, 64] (proj_out).

block00_modulation.f32.description: Shared modulation [2, 16384]: row 0 = sigma, row 1 = t 0.

block00_q_head0.f32.description: q after RMSNorm and RoPE, head 0 [36, 128].

block00_target_out.f32.description: Target-token slice of the model output [16, 64].

block00_temb.f32.description: time_text_embed output [2, 4096]: row 0 = sigma, row 1 = t 0.

block31_block_in.f32.description: Block input [36, 4096]: 20 text then 16 image tokens.

block31_cached_out.f32.description: Cached-path model output for the target tokens [16, 64] at sigma 0.704534.

block31_k_head0.f32.description: k after RMSNorm and RoPE, head 0 [36, 128].

block31_model_out.f32.description: Model output over the joint sequence [36, 64] (proj_out).

block31_modulation.f32.description: Shared modulation [2, 16384]: row 0 = sigma, row 1 = t 0.

block31_q_head0.f32.description: q after RMSNorm and RoPE, head 0 [36, 128].

block31_target_out.f32.description: Target-token slice of the model output [16, 64].

block31_temb.f32.description: time_text_embed output [2, 4096]: row 0 = sigma, row 1 = t 0.

block_in_encoder.f32.description: Seeded randn [20, 4096] * 1.0 text features (same stream, second).

block_in_latents.f32.description: Seeded randn [16, 64] target latent tokens (seed 1234 stream, first).

convrot.json.description: Cosine and error of the Comfy INT8 convrot weights against the official BF16 weights for block 0 attn.to_q, img_mlp.gate_up and img_mlp.out, with seeded inputs and outputs.

convrot_attn_to_q_q64.f32.description: INT8 weight top-left 64 x 64 (as f32, exact).

convrot_attn_to_q_y_bf16.f32.description: x . W^T with the official BF16 weight(s) upcast, f64 accumulate [8, 4096].

convrot_attn_to_q_y_int8.f32.description: rot(x) . (q * scale)^T from the Comfy INT8 weight, f64 accumulate.

convrot_hadamard_row0.f32.description: First row of the group-256 normalised Hadamard H (kron^4 of H4, / 16).

convrot_img_mlp_gate_up_q64.f32.description: INT8 weight top-left 64 x 64 (as f32, exact).

convrot_img_mlp_gate_up_y_bf16.f32.description: x . W^T with the official BF16 weight(s) upcast, f64 accumulate [8, 24576].

convrot_img_mlp_gate_up_y_int8.f32.description: rot(x) . (q * scale)^T from the Comfy INT8 weight, f64 accumulate.

convrot_img_mlp_out_q64.f32.description: INT8 weight top-left 64 x 64 (as f32, exact).

convrot_img_mlp_out_y_bf16.f32.description: x . W^T with the official BF16 weight(s) upcast, f64 accumulate [8, 4096].

convrot_img_mlp_out_y_int8.f32.description: rot(x) . (q * scale)^T from the Comfy INT8 weight, f64 accumulate.

embed.json.description: Timestep embedding, shared modulation and txt_in on the real Turbo weights (f32 math) at sigma 1.0, 0.414568, 0.02 and the t = 0 row.

embed_sigma0.02_sinusoid.f32.description: Sinusoid(256) at sigma 0.02: cos then sin.

embed_sigma0.414568_sinusoid.f32.description: Sinusoid(256) at sigma 0.414568: cos then sin.

embed_sigma1.0_sinusoid.f32.description: Sinusoid(256) at sigma 1.0: cos then sin.

embed_t0_sinusoid.f32.description: Sinusoid(256) at sigma 0.0: cos then sin.

embed_txt_in_normed.f32.description: txt_in.text_norm output: zero-centred RMSNorm, eps 1e-6, scale = weight + 1.

embed_txt_in_out.f32.description: txt_in output [12, 4096]: norm, in_layer, GELU(tanh), out_layer, no biases.

rope.json.description: RoPE table for 10 text tokens followed by a 4 x 6 latent block, with per-axis positions, plus a rotation of a seeded q.

rope_cos.f32.description: cos of the rotary table [34, 64]: 16 frame + 28 height + 28 width pairs.

rope_q_in.f32.description: Seeded q [34, 2 heads, 128] (seed 3) for the rotation check.

rope_q_out.f32.description: apply_rotary_emb_qwen(q, table): consecutive pairs (x[2i], x[2i+1]) rotated as complex.

sigmas.json.description: Sampling schedules from the pipeline's own calculate_shift/retrieve_timesteps: Turbo (model_index sample_sigmas, no shift) at 512/1024/2048 px and base (dynamic exponential shift, shift_terminal) at 40 steps for 1024/2048 px and 8 steps for 512 px. sigmas has the terminal 0 appended; timesteps = sigma * 1000.

sigmas_step_prev.f32.description: scheduler.step(v, t0, x): x + (sigma1 - sigma0) * v.

sigmas_step_v.f32.description: Seeded model output for the Euler step check.

sigmas_step_x.f32.description: Seeded sample for the Euler step check (turbo 1024 step 0).

te_cat_hidden.f32.description: Prompt features [kept tokens, 4096] for 'cat': output of the last decoder layer (35), before the final RMSNorm, after drop_idx.

te_cat_layer05.f32.description: Residual stream after 0-indexed decoder layer 5 for 'cat', after drop_idx (debugging).

te_cat_layer11.f32.description: Residual stream after 0-indexed decoder layer 11 for 'cat', after drop_idx (debugging).

te_cat_layer17.f32.description: Residual stream after 0-indexed decoder layer 17 for 'cat', after drop_idx (debugging).

te_cat_layer23.f32.description: Residual stream after 0-indexed decoder layer 23 for 'cat', after drop_idx (debugging).

te_cat_layer29.f32.description: Residual stream after 0-indexed decoder layer 29 for 'cat', after drop_idx (debugging).

te_scene60_hidden.f32.description: Prompt features [kept tokens, 4096] for 'scene60': output of the last decoder layer (35), before the final RMSNorm, after drop_idx.

te_scene60_layer05.f32.description: Residual stream after 0-indexed decoder layer 5 for 'scene60', after drop_idx (debugging).

te_scene60_layer11.f32.description: Residual stream after 0-indexed decoder layer 11 for 'scene60', after drop_idx (debugging).

te_scene60_layer17.f32.description: Residual stream after 0-indexed decoder layer 17 for 'scene60', after drop_idx (debugging).

te_scene60_layer23.f32.description: Residual stream after 0-indexed decoder layer 23 for 'scene60', after drop_idx (debugging).

te_scene60_layer29.f32.description: Residual stream after 0-indexed decoder layer 29 for 'scene60', after drop_idx (debugging).

te_streamed.json.description: Qwen3-VL-8B text encoder prompt features (f32 over the official BF16 weights), computed one decoder layer at a time, with every sixth layer's residual stream, and the two-layer cross-check against the pipeline's own code.

tokenizer.json.description: Full token ids the pipeline's text encoder sees for each prompt (pipeline template, drop_idx), the kept ids after dropping the system prefix, and the tokens as strings. Literal special-token text in a prompt is encoded as the special id (tokenizer default).

vae.json.description: AutoencoderKLQwenImage21 decode (f32) of a seeded 16 x 16 latent to 256 x 256 RGBA, with post_quant_conv, decoder.conv_in and mid-block activations.

vae_latents_packed.f32.description: Seeded randn [256, 64] packed latents (seed 77): the pipeline's tokens x channels layout, PRE-denorm.

vae_latents_post_denorm.f32.description: The decode input [64, 16, 16]: unpacked, then * latents_std + latents_mean (POST-denorm).
